title: Rehoboam Builds Fortified Cities
description: After the prophet Shemaiah, on the Lord's command, warns Rehoboam not to go to war against his brothers in the north, the army returns. Rehoboam stays in Jerusalem and builds up a number of fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin, including Bethlehem, Tekoa, Lachish, and Hebron. He strengthens the fortifications, places commanders over them, and stores large supplies of food, oil, and wine, as well as shields and spears, to secure the kingdom.
